name: PictureEffects
description: Represents a collection of PictureEffect objects.
remarks: Picture effects are processed as a chain composed of individual items that are applied in sequence to create the final composited image. An effects chain will allow an effect to be added to the chain, reordered, or removed from the chain.
example:
Sub PictureEffectSample()
' Setup a slide with one picture shape.
With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes(1).Fill.PictureEffects

 ' Insert a 150% Saturation effect.
 .Insert(msoEffectSaturation).EffectParameters(1).Value = 1.5

 ' Insert Brightness/Contrast effect and set values to -50% Brightness and +25% Contrast.
 Dim brightnessContrast As PictureEffect
 Set brightnessContrast = .Insert(msoEffectBrightnessContrast)
 brightnessContrast.EffectParameters(1).Value = -0.5
 brightnessContrast.EffectParameters(2).Value = 0.25

 ' Remove all Picture effects.
 While .Count > 0
 .Delete (1)
 Wend

End With
End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the PictureEffects object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the PictureEffects object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Retrieves a PictureEffect object at the specified index. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Retrieves the count of the number of PictureEffect objects contained within the PictureEffects collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Insert
methods.signature: Insert(EffectType As MsoPictureEffectType, [Position As Long]) As PictureEffect
methods.description: Inserts a picture effect in a chain of composite effects.

parameters.name: EffectType
parameters.description: An enumeration specifying the type of picture effect.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: The position of the effect in the composite chain of picture effects.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a PictureEffect object from the collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the PictureEffect object to delete.
